thumbnail_prompt:
ARM A - EVOLVED LOOK (final prompt, 2026-11-28):
16:9 YouTube thumbnail in traditional Indian miniature painting style (Kangra / Pahari school): flat perspective with no realistic 3D lighting, fine ink outlines, matte gouache colour, delicate patterned textiles, a stylised face in three-quarter profile. NO ornate border and NO parchment panel: the painting fills the frame edge to edge. Deep jewel-tone dusk palette: violet and plum sky, a rose-red setting sun over distant hills, gold firefly accents. A single figure at rest: a woman lying back in a rope hammock tied to a large flowering tree, one arm behind her head and the other trailing, eyes closed, completely at ease. Her face, arms and blouse are painted in light warm tones so she stands out clearly against the dark tree and sky; pale cream blouse, rose-pink patterned sari. A still lotus pond in the foreground, fireflies, no palace or domes. Simple clothing, no heavy jewellery. At the base of the tree, small and in shadow, a sarangi: a short, boxy, waisted bowed instrument with a wide flat neck and many tuning pegs along its side, NOT a violin, not played. Text: "YOU CAN PAUSE" in a BOLD warm cream classical serif typeface with strong thick-and-thin strokes (the same heavy weight as a bold Roman book title), large, upper left, about two-thirds of the frame width, not covering the figure.

ARM B - CURRENT LOOK (control): the usual Raga Focus Pichwai-Kangra miniature - ornate floral border, cream parchment text panel (right ~40%), dark indigo serif. Same scene as Arm A. Text in the panel: "YOU CAN PAUSE".

description:
It's Okay to Slow Down | 1.5 Hours

You do not have to earn a pause. You can just take one.

Soft, slow instrumental music for the moment you finally let yourself stop: long, voice-like phrases that ask nothing of you, for rest, deep breathing and doing absolutely nothing for a while.

▶ Keep going - the full Meditation playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199nvhUBCx5L9ROrDP44H4JzN
